opening.argument: The video presents a payment-based Forsage X4 plan built around purchased smart contracts, level-based payments, and upline placement. Its graphic links “PURCHASED SMART CONTRACT” to “PAYS YOU” and “UPLINE,” while the speaker explains that bringing someone on at a particular level can generate payments across levels. The speaker also says, “You'll get paid .025 for level one, .05 for level two,” and describes payments filling level bubbles. Although payments may occur without a referral, the speaker still urges viewers, “Just make the post. Put a little bit of work into this and you'll see it pays off.” That combination frames participation and effort as a route to returns, rather than offering a neutral explanation of the arrangement.
